description.en: Spends 3DS Play Coins through the console's system: at most 20 at a time (a larger number, or a failed request, spends nothing). The game's count is updated on success.
Number of Play Coins to spend, 0 to 20.

Always true, whether or not the coins were spent (check with CMND_GET_GAMECOIN).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Spending Play Coins for friendship points (real usage, from ev44029999.nut)
